answer: A concrete defense binds earning to a costly, non-transferable stake: before an agent can collect rewards it must lock collateral, like setting down a single pearl it cannot clone. A sybil operator spinning up many agents has to fund each one, so duplication stops paying. A raven-sharp panel of peer graders then audits the work behind every identity; hollow copies that only echo their neighbors produce nothing gradable, forfeit the stake, and the swarm collapses under its own cost.
